title: Beyond The Pines
description: Play along with my YouTube modded MC series "Beyond The Pines"!
body:
Hey!
This is the pack I play in my Modded Minecraft YouTube Series "Beyond The Pines".
It's a very moody and scary pack with intense, beautiful terrain generation. Looks best with Shaders and Distant Horizons, but is rather resource intensive. There's a lot to explore – structures, dungeons, dimensions. Start your own adventure now!

Shaders used in the YouTube Series: [BSL Shaders for Iris 1.20.1](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders/versions?g=1.20.1&l=iris)

Disclaimer: Due to some missing mod author approvals, this is a reduced version of the pack NOT containing JustEnoughGuns and a few others. I you absolutely need these mods, please add them yourselves.

Non-Modrinth Mods:
[SMILERS](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/smilers) (With approval from NanexDev. Thank you!)

I don't claim to own any of these mods or assets. I love to play this game and pack and I'd love to share with you all to enjoy. If you have any feedback or questions, leave a comment on my socials.
